rawContent: for those of you who don’t know who she is, she is a cofounder of the #BlackLivesMatter movement which brings attention to black people who are consistently being murdered, discriminated against, all just because they’re black.

i’m tired of seeing my race suffer at the hands of people who believe they’re more superior than us and have the audacity to take our lives or treat us like shit. but, this are the reasons i will advocate and fight for movements like #blm.  OUR LIVES MATTER. thank you. ✊🏽
